mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 68 degrees under a New Moon near the Military Ridge State Trail, with an overnight low of 64 degrees and no rain expected.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers for various programs and reminds everyone to respect participant confidentiality, while the city also notes that road construction on Highway M begins on August 18.
We have a busy lineup with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia all happening today, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.

The flavor of the day is Devil's Food Cake. Since the store is currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when they open tomorrow at 10 AM, or try the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor coming up tomorrow.
